release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.8

• **Edge-to-Edge Fullscreen UI (Standard & Minimalist)**: Redesigned Fullscreen Now Playing with edge-to-edge full-bleed cover/motion artwork fading into deep cover-tinted backdrops, glowing harmonic wave scrubber with negative remaining time, real quality pill, frosted transport capsules, and live synced lyric line preview in Minimalist Mode.
• **Fixed Video Cover Art Pausing Song in Fullscreen**: Added mixWithOthers audio focus isolation on animated cover controllers so entering fullscreen keeps the song playing smoothly alongside looping artwork.
• **Spotify Canvas Support & Minimalist m-lyrics Animation**: Extended motion cover resolution to support vertical Spotify Canvas loops and added expressive left-aligned Minimalist lyrics with spring slide, distance blur, and syllable lift.
• **Shazam Recognition (Android & Windows)**: Added native Windows WinMM mic capture + Shazam-style spectral constellation peak fingerprinting (plus optional AudD/webhook lookup) accessible right from Search.
• **Pluggable Lossless Modules + Streaming Fallback, Radio Builder, Daily Replay Mix & 8D Audio**: Added external lossless module configuration & health checks, a multi-artist/song/genre Radio Builder, Daily Replay Mix from your most-played tracks, and Rust DSP 8D 360-degree orbiting audio in Settings.
